sources.ref: Syllabus for JEE (Main) - 2027 (National Testing Agency, published 2026-10-24; linked from https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/)

notes: Depth is 4 by default (the highest level the exam needs, per the syllabus-mapper depth table: L3 easy and medium, L4 hard); it is lowered only where the official syllabus line limits treatment (for example 'qualitative idea only', 'elementary idea', 'no derivation', 'brief account', 'recall only'). Priority is core for every concept: the official syllabus marks nothing optional. weightage and pyq_count stay null until pyq-ingest computes them.
